{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows strong mean reversion toward lower levels and sentiment is bearish.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is consistently negative and historical mean is below recent highs.",
    "Apply upward correction if sentiment turns positive after prolonged bearish periods and price is below historical mean.",
    "Smooth out forecast volatility when sentiment is flat (0.00) and historical price range is narrow.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude if sentiment is negative and true outcome consistently underperforms model highs.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts near price extremes — e.g., if sentiment turns positive after a dip, anticipate rebound."
  ]
}
